basic_info.description: Back in the market. This approximately 2,408 square foot home features 2 units, one with 3 bedroom/1 bath and the other, being a studio with one bath. The duplex/flat offers a spacious layout with ample windows, providing a bright, open atmosphere and abundant natural light. Its convenient location offers great functionality and potential. The home boasts a warm color palette and a charming brick deco fireplace,complemented by hardwood flooring that extends throughout the spacious layout. The  generously sized kitchen includes ample cabinetry. This 3-story multifamily property, built in 1924, includes two units and a one-car garage. This location has easy access to transit and  the freeway. The property will be delivered vacant. Bring your CONTRACTOR! This property is in probate with No Court Confirmation.
